title: "08 · Multi-agent coordination"
---

When does splitting roles improve a shared outcome?

## Concepts

Compare a single controller with proposer–reviewer and parallel-worker designs. Specify delegation, handoff artifacts, conflict resolution, and shared budgets [@anthropic2024effectiveagents].

## Study task

Design a proposer and an independent reviewer for experiment configs. Compare their handoff with a single proposer and deterministic validator at a matched cost.

## Deliverable

Submit a message contract, a tie-resolution rule, and an ablation that could show the reviewer adds little value.
